name: Autonomy Control
description: Control YOUR OWN autonomous mode (live background wakes). Use it when the user tells you "start yourself", "stop yourself" or asks "are you active/running?": action 'start' turns your autonomous mode on, 'stop' turns it off and cancels a wake in flight, 'status' reports whether you are active plus last/next wake and pending events. Acts only on yourself; the setting persists across restarts.

action.description: start = turn your autonomous mode on; stop = turn it off; status = report your current state
